items.computation: Invoice date (Rechnungsdatum) is 2026-11-21 (a Saturday). This is a contractual payment term counted under § 187(1) BGB: the day of the triggering event (invoice date) is excluded, so the 14-day period runs from 2026-11-22 through 2026-12-05. 2026-12-05 falls on a Saturday.
